event_summary: A small brown rounded object moves from the left side of a tabletop to the right side and exits the frame while a white rectangular block remains in place.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a light wood tabletop, a white textured rectangular block near the upper center, and a partially visible black cylindrical object at the left edge. After many static frames, a small brown rounded object appears from the left side on the tabletop, travels rightward across the front area below the white block, and exits at the right edge. The white block, tabletop, black side object, and background remain visually unchanged.

reasons: The tabletop, white block, left-edge black object, and background are visible.
The later-moving brown object is not visible in the first frame.
